# orbivisor_certificate (Resource)

An ACME certificate for the API/web listener (the cluster orders and renews it).

Manifest kind `Certificate`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) ACME account name.
- `challenge` (Dynamic) `{ kind = "http01" }` or `{ kind = "dns01", dns = "provider" }`.
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `names` (List of String) DNS names (`{node}` expands per node).

### Optional

- `install` (String)
- `key` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `precheck` (Boolean)
- `preferred_chain` (String)
- `profile` (String)
- `renew` (Dynamic)
- `scope` (Dynamic) Per node or shared.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).
